args.query: HikariPool connection pool exhausted portfolio timeout

events.statement: api-gateway p99 latency (~206ms) rose sharply at 09:50 to 3119.97ms and settled ~4300ms; onset between 09:40 and 09:50.
api-gateway error_rate (~0.2%) rose to 4.44% at 09:50 and ~7.2% thereafter.
Only deployment in window: dep-5220 api-gateway v9.3.0 at 08:00, 'enable HTTP/2 to upstreams', live, not rolled back.
Config change cfg-2207 changed portfolio-service db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5 at 09:52:00Z.
portfolio-service log confirms the config application 1 minute before failures: 'config change cfg-2207 applied: db.pool.max_size=5' at 09:52:13.
portfolio-service latency rose from ~180ms to 3031.47ms at 09:50 and ~4200ms after.
portfolio-service error_rate rose from ~0.2% to 13.5% at 09:50 and ~22% after.

portfolio-service HikariPool exhausted: 'Connection is not available, request timed out after 3000ms (total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=43)' at 09:54:29; also 'could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms'.
portfolio-service db_pool_in_use was ~12 baseline and clamped at exactly 5.0 from 10:00 onward (max=5).
portfolio-service request_rate was steady ~550-580 req/s before and during the incident (09:30 avg 567.1, 10:00 avg 572.27) — no load spike.
api-gateway logged 73 'upstream timeout portfolio-service GET /v1/portfolio/holdings -> 504' WARNs starting 09:53:53.
ledger-db cpu_pct flat ~30%, slow_queries_per_min flat ~1.0, connections_active fell from ~62 to ~55 — DB healthy, not saturated.
order-service and payment-service error_rate stayed flat ~0.2% across 08:00-11:59 despite also using shared ledger-db.
The api-gateway HTTP/2 upgrade (dep-5220, 08:00) is not the trigger: latency/errors stayed normal for ~1h45m after it, and onset coincides with cfg-2207 (09:52).
Failure propagates gateway -> portfolio-service -> datasource pool: pool max 5 saturates under ~565 req/s, triggering 3s acquisition timeouts and 504s at the gateway.
